paragraphs.source_en: *Objection:* Your price is too high. *Point of Agreement*: I understand that money is an important issue to you. *Question to Clarify*: Can you share with me the criteria you use when choosing a vendor?

paragraphs.source_en: *Objection:* There is no money in the budget. *Point of Agreement*: Well, I can certainly agree that managing your finances is crucial when doing business. *Questions to Clarify*: (1) Is it a budgetary concern or not being convinced of the value you will receive?
